_readme: Registry of the identifiers the engine knows how to resolve.
This is the shared contract: the engine (Ruby), the views (JS) and the validator all read THIS file.
A card using a value not listed here is rejected at validation time, not at runtime.
Adding a value here is a design decision: it commits the engine to resolving it.
Rules source: docs/MANUALE.md (Italian). Card terms map as:
Flow=Flusso, HP=PV, Fury=Furia, Entity=Entita, Power=Potenza, Matter=Materia,
Union=Unione, Recall Zone=Zona di Richiamo, Front=Fronte, Discard pile=Pila degli scarti.

keyword._note: Keyword abilities with rules predefined by the manual (MANUALE.md §8.1)

effect._note: Effect types the engine must be able to resolve

timing._note: Windows in which an action may be activated (MANUALE.md §6)

state._note: States an Entity can be in (MANUALE.md §6.3). 'covered' blocks every action and suspends its Matters

zone._note: Game zones (MANUALE.md §5). Ownership is expressed with 'owner', never baked into the zone name

zoneOwner._note: Who the referenced zone belongs to. 'card_owner' is the owner of the card involved, which is not necessarily the player resolving the effect

duration._note: How long a continuous effect lasts

matter._note: Matter types (MANUALE.md §7.1). Dynamic, dimensional and destructive have grades 1-2; zero and dominant have none

cardType._note: Card types. The Rubyfront is its own type: it is not an Entity

match._note: How multiple conditions combine: field 'match', alongside 'conditions'

operator._note: How a value is compared: field 'operator', alongside 'stat' and 'value'
